description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS version, providing improved performance, security patches, and access to modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build tool configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all compiler settings, toolchains, and CI/CD pipelines reference Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version, Dockerfile build and runtime stages. Build and tests pass with JDK 25.
